segments.title: A super RARE US snake lives where?
segments.say: One of America's rarest snakes lives where? A desert, an airport, or a volcano? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Next to an AIRPORT!
segments.say: Next to an airport! Near San Francisco's airport.

segments.title: San Francisco garter snake
segments.say: It's the San Francisco garter snake, endangered and super colorful.

segments.title: 62 young snakes released
segments.say: Sixty-two young snakes, bred at the San Francisco Zoo, were just released.

segments.title: A FIRST, ever
segments.say: It's the first time they've ever been released into the wild.
Follow for Weird Animal number 28 tomorrow.
